caseName: Worldwide Church of God, Inc. v. Superior Court of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: Worldwide Church of God, Inc. v. Superior Court for the County of Los Angeles (California, Real Party in Interest)

opinions.text:
Application for stay.of judgment of the Superior Court of the State of California for the County of Los Angeles, entered December 31, 1979, presented to Mr. Chief Justice Burger, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
